contract.purpose: Decide whether a changed inventory identity should update, remove or create a cycle-count request.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration; placeholders are not executable argument values: CREATE PROCEDURE CCP_CheckToUpdateCCRequest( @Item nvarchar(50), @ItemDesc nvarchar(100), @Comp nvarchar(25), @Lot nvarchar(25), @Loc nvarchar(25), @Whs nvarchar(25), @ContId nvarchar(50), @locInvAttributesId numeric(9), @NewOnHandQty numeric(19,5), @UserName nvarchar(30), @CCAction int output) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Most item/company/lot/unit predicates are explicitly NULL-aware; attributes normalize NULL/zero in selected comparisons. Multiple matching inventory rows assign quantity without ordering. NOT IN parent cleanup is NULL-sensitive. An incoming CCAction is not reset.
output_shape: CCAction OUTPUT is assigned on two terminal branches only. Existence SELECT statements can return ALLOCATION_LOC from ITEM_LOCATION_ASSIGNMENT and LOCATION from CYCLE_COUNT_REQUEST. Explicit return is -1 for the final observed error, otherwise 0.

ordered_branches.explanation: Initialize internal action flags, check permanent assignment and existing request conditions. The supplied NewOnHandQty is never read. Existence checks use SELECT ALLOCATION_LOC or SELECT LOCATION and can emit single-column row sets.

When the target request condition is absent, compare positive attribute identities through a cursor and INVfn_AreInvAttributeValuesSame, then consider creation or replacement of an empty permanent-location request.
For an existing target request, read stored ON_HAND_QTY. A zero quantity can clear inventory identity; another request at the location can instead select the removal branch.

The update branch rewrites matching request identity and corresponding cycle-count work fields; it does not rewrite the work FROM_LOC_INV_ATTRIBUTES_ID. The removal branch deletes matching requests and detail work, then deletes eligible parent work whose identity is NOT IN the remaining parent references.
Set the caller CCAction OUTPUT to -1 only for the skip branch or 1 only for the create branch. Other paths preserve its incoming value.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: Can clear item/company/lot/unit/attribute identity, update requests and work, or delete requests and work. It does not write stock quantities.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: Location/warehouse and inventory identity determine request selection; permanent assignment changes empty-location handling. Coded condition/action/type equality groups were verified privately; actual application callers remain unobserved.
error_and_return_handling: The final @@ERROR check is statement-local and does not guarantee that earlier errors were detected. No TRY/CATCH or compensation.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit BEGIN TRANSACTION, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, savepoint or SET XACT_ABORT in this body. Caller/session transaction behavior governs partial completion; this contract does not assume atomic child calls.
concurrency: Several existence checks, cursor comparisons and subsequent writes are separate statements with no local serialization.
contract.trigger_behavior: Captured attached triggers: work_instruction_outgoing_pd (AFTER INSERT; enabled). Their INSERT event does not fire merely because this routine updates or deletes the table.
